items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled OUT for Week 2 vs Bengals with hamstring injury sustained in practice.
items.why: Hamstring injury in Wednesday practice; did not practice Thu/Fri; not serious but sits Week 2.
items.implication: Stroud loses top target; Schultz and secondary WRs see major target increase.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz TE1 upside; Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel flex options.

items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring) unlikely to play Sunday vs Jaguars despite questionable tag.
items.opportunity: Decent look at handcuff/backup (Jonah Coleman per Levitan).

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved steadily, team did not elevate WR; optimism he can play today barring setback. Expected to wear flak jacket if active.
items.why: Improved more than anticipated; pushing to play; bullish tone from sources.
items.implication: Project in with injury docks; official status likely ~2:30pm ET.
items.opportunity: If out, Quentin Johnston and others gain volume.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury aggravated in Week 1; officially downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Major loss of targets; Andrews and other Ravens pass-catchers elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for Mark Andrews and remaining WRs.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.why: Foot injury; officially ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Opens WR targets in Pittsburgh offense.
items.opportunity: Volume bump for remaining Steelers receivers and potentially TE.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status likely late (2:30pm ET). Puka true GTD. Olave fine no docks. Decent look at backup RB with Harvey doubtful and Germie Bernard with Pittman out.
items.why: ETR projections updated for news; bullish McConkey, clean Olave.
items.implication: Start McConkey with caution; pivot plans for Puka/Harvey/Pittman.
items.opportunity: Backup RB/WR volume if outs confirmed.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) expected to play Sunday at Houston; team elevated Josh Johnson as precaution.
items.why: Listed Q but expected; elevated backup Saturday.
items.implication: Full starter; Chase/Higgins stack intact vs Texans sans Collins.
items.opportunity: QB1 play with elevated WR opportunity opposite.

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip) a pre-game decision for Monday night vs Giants; listed questionable, no practice Fri/Sat.
items.why: Hip injury (or groin soreness per McVay); different from prior psoas; true GTD.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out heavier TE usage and secondary WRs.
items.opportunity: If inactive, Davante Adams or others, plus TEs Ferguson/Parkinson.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) expected to play Sunday at Baltimore.
items.why: Sources confirm expected; made trip; no major docks.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected; Chase Young also expected.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) doubtful; elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White.
items.why: Knee; elevated backups; will test but doubtful.
items.implication: Michael Mayer sees heavy TE targets again.

items.text: Updated Week 2 tiers: Michael Mayer TE10 upgrade (rocket); flags on Puka WR3 and Ladd WR22 injury uncertainty.
items.why: Bowers doubtful drives Mayer up; injury docks on Puka/Ladd.
items.implication: Start Mayer as TE1; caution on Puka/Ladd.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snap rate, 21/24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1, 40% target share on routes; Indy just allowed 163 yards/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization + juicy matchup vs soft Indy run D.

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite utilization and consistent heavy workload.

items.text: Loves Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util Week 1, 26% target share, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; CHI soft vs WRs.
items.why: High volume with Wentz + favorable matchup history.

items.text: Loves Dak Prescott vs WAS: home smash, WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Week 1; DAL top-5 implied total in high-total game.
items.why: Elite home spot vs leaky WAS secondary + high total.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rushes Week 1, most points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; underdog script bad for rushes.
items.why: Split backfield + Kamara return + tough matchup/script.

items.text: Hates Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: only 8% target share Week 1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA tough vs WRs.
